en.t: Now, listen to what I have to tell you.
That, of course, is complete nonsense.

units.source_text: 既然大家都知道他在胡扯，那么就和说真话没什么区别了。

en.t: Since everyone knows he is talking nonsense, it is no different from telling the truth.

units.source_text: 你认为它说的都是假话，那只是你的个人偏见。

en.t: Your belief that everything it says is false is merely your own personal prejudice.
What I want to talk about is Lope.

units.source_text: 表面上啰培领导着喀拉克斯党，而实际上操纵啰培的是Pou-Fou日报

en.t: On the surface, Lope leads the Klax Party, but in reality the one manipulating Lope is the Pou-Fou Daily

units.source_text: （“卟—弗”一词也是个没有实际意义的感叹词。

en.t: The word Pou-Fou is also an interjection with no real meaning.

units.source_text: 非要翻译出来，就只能翻译成“啊”）的社长哙哙。

en.t: If one insists on translating it, it can only be rendered as ah, and its president is Kuaikui.

units.source_text: 但哙哙也不是真正的主人。

en.t: But Kuaikui is not the real master either.

units.source_text: 他的主人就是坐在你面前的嘎尔。”

en.t: His master is Gaer, the one sitting right in front of you.
